verdict.rationale: Jitsu's evidence covers event collection, streaming to warehouses, Functions for filtering/enrichment, and a Profile Builder that creates customer profiles stored in the warehouse, but there is no mention of building audience segments with entry/exit membership logic or syncing those audiences continuously to ad platforms (e.g., Facebook/Google Ads) or engagement tools. Community feedback even highlights the opposite direction — pulling ad-platform data into the warehouse, not pushing audiences out — with a commenter noting a 'higher bar to implementation' versus Segment for exactly this kind of activation. Missing for 10: audience/segment builder with membership rules, dedicated ad-platform audience sync connectors, near-real-time membership add/remove sync mechanism.
